text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired for host gpu-node-7b4 (us-west-2a) — symptom: host unresponsive / softlock; kubelet NotReady. Affected: inference-serving-prod (10 pods) — impact: requests returning 502/timeout, autoscaler dropping capacity. PD: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INVITE-12345 :rotating_light:

maria_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Pulling telemetry and trying serial console attach.

kevin_sre: +1, if it's a host softlock let's avoid immediate reboot until we confirm PVs and critical pods are drained. Can you cordon?

maria_oncall: cordoning now -> `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7b4 --context=prod`

maria_oncall: running drain with grace 60s for non-critical, leaving statefulsets alone:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-7b4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --force
```

maria_oncall: drain in progress, 6/10 pods evicted, 4 pending because of local storage. Noted.

deploy-bot: Detected increase in 5xx from inference-proxy-prod. Canary rollback triggered? No, traffic still routing.

kevin_sre: can you paste dmesg/serial logs if you get console? Might be kernel OOM or driver hang.

maria_oncall: attaching serial console now (ipmi -> serialoverlan). If anyone wants live, @chip_infra please join - I might need hardware toggle.

chip_infra: on it, joining serial. If it's a GPU firmware hang we'll likely need host reboot + RMA.

maria_oncall: serial shows repeating stacktrace snippets, ps shows init threads alive but unresponsive. snippet:
```
BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 23s! [kworker/3:2]
Call Trace:
 <long trace omitted>
nvidia: GPU HANG detected, resetting device
```

kevin_sre: that aligns w/ NVidia driver hang. Recommend migrate remaining pods off and then power-cycle. Is there any live customer-facing degradation beyond increased latency?

dena_support: Support ticket influx: 3 customers reported intermittent 502s in last 10m, one on Dedicated; we'll triage. Marking potential impact: partial degraded serving in us-west-2 region.

maria_oncall: remaining 4 pods recrated onto other nodes 2/4 succeeded, 2 blocked due to PVC on local NVMe. I'll try to copy logs to a temp S3 and then force-stop.

kevin_sre: agreed — we should evacuate the node. Prepare for controlled reboot. Document steps and notify infra for RMA.

maria_oncall: running `kubectl annotate node gpu-node-7b4 redwood/evac=planned` and `kubectl get pods -o wide` to confirm.

maria_oncall: marking node unschedulable and scheduling drain finalizers.

chip_infra: hardware confirms power cycle OK. I'll perform an orderly soft power cycle via iLO/IPMI in 2m and watch serial. If it fails to come up we'll escalate to onsite RMA.

maria_oncall: creating incident runbook entry, linking PD incident -> https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD-INVITE-12345. Noting timeline and commands used.

kevin_sre: quick checklist for post-reboot:
- verify kubelet registers and ready
- check nvme + nvidia driver logs `/var/log/messages`, `dmesg`
- validate pods with local storage restored or mark PVCs for migration
- check inference tail latencies and 5xx rates

maria_oncall: chip executed power-cycle at 7543211100. Serial shows bootloader, kernel starting. Kubelet still not Ready — waiting on containerd to start.

maria_oncall: kubelet came up at 7543211300, node Ready=No (some system pods CrashLoopBackOff). Investigating...

kevin_sre: check `systemctl status nvidia-driver` and `journalctl -u kubelet -b`

maria_oncall: nvidia kernel module failed to load, `nvidia-modeset` errors present. Logs: `nvidia: Found unsupported GPU - firmware panic`.

chip_infra: confirming firmware panic. Placing hardware RMA with vendor. ETA for replacement blade ~48 hours.

dena_support: updating affected customers: advising degraded capacity in us-west-2 and automatic retries in SDK. Drafting message now.

maria_oncall: temporary mitigation: re-schedule impacted workloads to Dedicated fallback pool via routing policy — applied policy for model-serving route `inference.latest` -> fallback-dedicated-usw.

kevin_sre: good. Monitor tail latencies and token costs — switching pools may change perf.

maria_oncall: Postmortem note prep started. Initial RCA hypothesis: GPU firmware hang triggered by driver edge-case under load; kernel softlock led to kubelet NotReady.

chip_infra: RMA ticket created: RMA-98765. Onsite will swap blade when available. For now node marked cordoned and decommissioned from cluster by infra.

maria_oncall: closing on-call steps: node cordoned, drained where possible, reboot attempted, RMA opened, fallback routing applied, customers notified. I'll hand off to oncall rotation for monitoring in 30m.

kevin_sre: thanks — ping when everything stabilizes. Good incident hygiene: link config snippets, exact commands, and logs to the PD ticket.

maria_oncall: ack. leaving notes in PD and posting runbook gist. `@dena_support` please watch open tickets and escalate to account teams if SLA at risk. :thumbsup:

dena_support: will monitor and escalate. updating thread with any new customer reports.

deploy-bot: Rollout watcher: no automatic rollbacks performed. Traffic shifted per routing policy.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by maria_oncall, status: mitigation in progress, severity: P1 -> monitoring.
